QuestInfo.name: [Extravagameza!] Spot the Difference Guide
QuestInfo.0: Spot the Differences in this puzzling game!\r\nUp to three players team up to find the differences between the two pictures. Score points by spotting as many as you can within the time limit. Purchase all kinds of neat rewards with the points you earn!\r\nInvitations for the game will go out at the 15-minute mark of every hour during the event!
